send: su 0 dmesg -n 1
i=0; while [ "$(getprop sys.boot_completed)" != 1 ] && [ $i -lt 900 ]; do sleep 3; i=$((i+3)); done; echo BOOTDONE=$(getprop sys.boot_completed) uptime=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime)
sleep 20

echo ===PROPS-BEGIN===; getprop | grep -E '^.(ro.build.(fingerprint|version.release)|ro.product.(device|model|name|cpu.abilist)|ro.boot.(slot_suffix|verifiedbootstate|boot_part_uuid|hardware|boot_devices|vbmeta|veritymode|openbook|lcd_density|serialno)|ro.hardware|vendor.anybook|vendor.openbook|ro.sf.lcd_density|ro.opengles|sys.boot_completed|ro.boottime|init.svc.vendor|init.svc.(console|surfaceflinger)|dev.bootcomplete|ro.crypto)'; echo ===PROPS-END===
echo ===BOOTCONFIG-BEGIN===; su 0 cat /proc/bootconfig; echo ===BOOTCONFIG-END===
echo ===CMDLINE-BEGIN===; cat /proc/cmdline; echo ===CMDLINE-END===
echo ===BYNAME-BEGIN===; su 0 ls -l /dev/block/by-name; echo ===BYNAME-END===
echo ===MOUNTS-BEGIN===; su 0 grep -E ' /(system|vendor|vendor_dlkm|system_dlkm|data|metadata|product|system_ext) ' /proc/mounts; su 0 df -h /data /metadata; echo ===MOUNTS-END===
echo ===MODULES-BEGIN===; su 0 cat /proc/modules | wc -l; su 0 cat /proc/modules | cut -d' ' -f1 | sort | tr '\n' ' '; echo; cat /proc/sys/kernel/tainted; echo ===MODULES-END===
echo ===PROBE-BEGIN===; su 0 dmesg | grep -E 'anybook_gpu_probe|openbook-pc-setup|modprobe|virtio_gpu|virtio-pci|\[drm\]|Boot device|vbmeta digest' | head -80; echo ===PROBE-END===

echo ===AVC-BEGIN===; su 0 dmesg | grep -c 'avc:  denied'; su 0 dmesg | grep 'avc:  denied' | sed -E 's/.*avc:  denied  (\{[^}]*\}).*scontext=u:r:([a-z0-9_]+):s0.*tcontext=u:object_r:([a-z0-9_]+):s0.*tclass=([a-z_]+).*/\1 \2 \3 \4/' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -40; echo ===AVC-END===

echo ===SERVICES-BEGIN===; service list | grep -E 'light|power|thermal|usb|weaver|keymint|gatekeeper|health|boot|composer|allocator|memtrack|authsecret|audio|sharedsecret|secureclock'; echo ===SERVICES-END===
echo ===VINTF-BEGIN===; su 0 lshal -i --types=aidl 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'light|power|thermal|usb|weaver|keymint|gatekeeper|health|boot|composer|allocator' | head -30; echo ===VINTF-END===
echo ===SF-BEGIN===; dumpsys SurfaceFlinger | grep -E 'GLES:|Display [0-9]+|HWC display|composer|present' | head -20; dumpsys SurfaceFlinger --display-id; echo ===SF-END===

echo ===WINDOW-BEGIN===; dumpsys window displays | grep -E 'mDisplayInfo|mWindowingMode|cur=|app=' | head -12; dumpsys input | grep -E 'Device [0-9]+:|Classes:|IsExternal' | head -24; echo ===WINDOW-END===
echo ===FEATURES-BEGIN===; pm list features | grep -E 'type.pc|vulkan|opengles|freeform|verified_boot|usb.host|hardware_keystore'; echo ===FEATURES-END===
echo ===HALS-BEGIN===; dumpsys thermalservice | head -40; dumpsys lights | head -12; dumpsys battery | head -14; echo ===HALS-END===
echo ===KEYSTORE-BEGIN===; su 0 dmesg | grep -iE 'keymint|keystore2|gatekeeper|weaver' | head -20; getprop | grep -E 'keystore|keymint' | head; echo ===KEYSTORE-END===
echo ===DGPU-BEGIN===; su 0 sh /vendor/bin/dgpu-power-check; echo exit=$?; su 0 /vendor/bin/openbook-pc-setup dgpu-pm; echo exit=$?; echo ===DGPU-END===
echo ===DGPU-FIXTURES-BEGIN===; su 0 sh -c 'TMPDIR=/data/local/tmp sh /vendor/bin/openbook-pc-setup-test sh /vendor/bin/openbook-pc-setup'; echo exit=$?; echo ===DGPU-FIXTURES-END===
echo ===LOCKSCREEN-BEGIN===; locksettings set-pin 1234; locksettings verify --old 1234; su 0 ls -l /data/vendor/weaver; echo ===LOCKSCREEN-END===
su 0 sync

echo ===DISPLAY-BEGIN===; getprop init.svc.bootanim; getprop service.bootanim.exit; dumpsys activity activities | grep -E 'ResumedActivity|mFocusedApp' | head -4; dumpsys window | grep -E 'mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp' | head -3; echo ===DISPLAY-END===
echo ===LOGCAT-BEGIN===; su 0 logcat -d -b all | gzip | base64; echo ===LOGCAT-END===
echo ===DMESG-BEGIN===; su 0 dmesg | gzip | base64; echo ===DMESG-END===
su 0 sync; su 0 reboot -p
